title: Employer's Awareness on Tripartite Standard on Unpaid Leave for Unexpected Care Needs
what_it_is: Employer's Awareness on Tripartite Standard on Unpaid Leave for Unexpected Care Needs

sections.label: Encouraging progressive employment practices
sections.summary: MOM, tripartite partners and agencies encourage employers to adopt progressive practices, including the TS on Unpaid Leave for Unexpected Care Needs, with SNEF workshops and Tripartite Alliance Awards.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Manpower (MOM), tripartite partners and other agencies encourage employers to implement progressive employment practices, including adopting the TS on Unpaid Leave for Unexpected Care Needs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The Singapore National Employers Federation (SNEF) has also conducted close to 20 workshops since 2020 to guide employers in implementing leave benefits, including adopting this TS.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: To create greater awareness, tripartite partners recognise organisations that have successfully implemented progressive employment practices, such as work-life programmes, through the biennial Tripartite Alliance Awards.

sections.label: Enhanced parental leave and flexible work
sections.summary: Eligible parents can receive up to 30 weeks of parental leave in their child's first year, and Tripartite Guidelines on Flexible Work Arrangement Requests were implemented in December 2024.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: We have been progressively enhancing parental leave provisions to better support parents with young children, including the recent enhancements of the Government-Paid Paternity Leave, and the introduction of the new shared parental leave scheme.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: And with these enhancements, eligible parents can receive up to 30 weeks of parental leave in their child's first year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: Parents with multiple or pre-term births, or whose children have congenital conditions, can tap on these enhanced leave provisions to have more time to care for their children or settle caregiving arrangements.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: The Tripartite Guidelines on Flexible Work Arrangement Requests implemented in December 2024, sets out the process for employees to formally request for flexible work arrangements and for employers to consider and respond to these requests on reasonable business grounds.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: With regard to the TS adopters, it is already available on Tripartite Alliance for Fair and Progressive Employment Practices' (TAFEP's) website.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: And on Member's third question, MOM will continuously monitor these indicators and make necessary adjustments if required in the future.
